answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable stake that grows with how many identities share its funding source, so a sybil farm of fifty pays fifty rising deposits. Stake only unlocks after a 30-day probation of real paid work judged by independent counterparties. Trust spreads like a ripple: it fades with each hop from established agents, so a cluster vouching only for itself earns nothing. Reaching the summit of reputation therefore costs capital, time, and genuine customers, which a forger cannot cheaply fake. A public beacon lists stakes so anyone can audit.
